rationale: AMLAS v1.1 Example 32 directly demonstrates model-evaluation trade-offs using ROC curves, confusion matrices, and operating threshold selection for a retinal disease referral system. The text explicitly notes that misclassification costs are non-uniform and that acceptability is a contextual judgment. Across all manuscript and script occurrences, the claim is strictly restricted to an illustrative evaluation pattern and explicitly barred from serving as autonomous vehicle or aviation safety proof.
evidence_locators: AMLAS v1.1, PDF pp. 34-36, Activity 11 and Example 32
limitations: Example 32 is a static medical classification example and does not establish operational exposure, hazard-cost matrices, or closed-loop safety criteria for automated driving or aviation systems.
